title: Mechanisms, subsystems, container
summary: How a real robot's code is organized.

board.code:
RobotContainer        // lists every subsystem
  ShooterSubsystem     // decides: when the button's held, spin up
    FlywheelMech       // knows how to spin a wheel at a speed
    RollerMech         // knows how to run a roller

steps.title: You've used one
steps.say: The drivetrain was a mechanism all along. This lesson wraps it in a subsystem and builds a shooter next to it.

steps.title: Open DrivetrainSubsystem.java
steps.say: Read the drivetrain subsystem first. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `DrivetrainSubsystem` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find case ARCADE
steps.say: Find the teleop state. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `case ARCADE` and press Enter to jump to it.

steps.title: ARCADE
steps.say: In the ARCADE state, drive with `drive.arcadeDrive(OI.getForward(), OI.getTurn());`.
